fields.Name: ORD-08 - Line Subscriber and Benefit Model
fields.Description: Per-line ship-to and the benefit model (LS1-LS8, D61/D62). Subscriptions were a HEADER concern, so every line shared one subscriber: an association buying ten memberships for ten staff needed ten orders, and under RejectDuplicate could not do it at all. Ship-to moved to the line (routing for physical goods, WHO the line is for when there is nothing to ship) and BenefitModel separates who HOLDS a subscription from who BENEFITS, which is what sets the dedupe scope.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: A line's ship-to org overrides the order customer; absent ship-to inherits the header per-side; ONE order with ten seats for ten people yields ten subscriptions and ten terms; an OrganizationMembers type dedupes on the org so a second purchase extends; a seat type refuses without both sides; an org-members type refuses a person-only holder; an explicit RenewsSubscriptionID extends that exact subscription.
